sources.notes: The Dreamcast cheat folder is imported whole. Each converted pack lists the disc product codes taken from the Redump metadata DAT of the same revision, so a pack is offered only for the discs it was written for. Blocks using unsupported code types, repeats or enable codes are excluded.
